The pump is also PWM-controlled and runs between 800 and 2800 rpm, providing constant and dependable cooling performance. The cold plate is composed of copper and has micro-skived fins, which considerably increase thermal conductivity and heat dissipation. Furthermore, the ARGB lighting provides a visually appealing aspect to your setup, transforming the Arctic Liquid Freezer III 420MM ARGB into not only a functional but also aesthetically pleasing complement to any build.

Ready Out-of-the-Box - Easy Installation

The Liquid Freezer III 420MM ARGB is ready for immediate use thanks to its pre-installed radiator fans in push configuration. The fan wires are integrated into the hose jacket, thus only one connection is required to connect to the motherboard. With the MX-6 thermal compound included in the purchase, you will have everything you need for a quick and easy installation.

Liquid Freezer III 420 ARGB– Tested and Confirmed by Intel

Intel has tested and approved the Liquid Freezer III 420MM ARGB for the i9-13900K/KF, i9-14900K/KF, and i9-13900KS Enthusiast and Desktop processors. In these tests, Intel considered both the mounting with contact frame and the cooler's performance.

Future-Proof Compatibility

The Liquid Freezer III 420MM ARGB works with both Intel and AMD sockets. Intel intends to release the new Arrow Lake CPUs with the LGA1851 socket in the future. We guarantee 100 percent compatibility. All Liquid Freezer III variants are completely compatible with Intel's new LGA 1851 socket.

Outstanding Performance

Independent testing show that the Liquid Freezer III 420MM ARGB surpasses the competition in all price categories due to its remarkable performance. In noise-normalized testing, the Liquid Freezer III displays its true strength, outperforming numerous competitors with its quiet yet powerful operation.

Silent and Powerful VRM Fan

When paired with power-hungry CPUs, motherboard voltage converters commonly work at their maximum temperatures. To compensate for the lack of airflow from a tower cooler, the Liquid Freezer III 420MM ARGB has a modified VRM fan. When VRM cooling is insufficient, ventilation is weak, or overclocking is occurring, the 60 mm PWM-controlled fan provides almost silent cooling of the socket area. This enables a continuous higher load and a longer service life for the voltage converters.

Optimised, In-House Developed Water Pump

The Liquid Freezer III 420MM ARGB features a specially built PWM-controlled water pump that has been further improved for performance and noise. The Liquid Freezer III's performance improves while staying quiet, owing to an upgraded coldplate with a larger fin surface and redesigned water pipes.

Addressable LEDs for all Requirements

ARCTIC employs standards 3-pin cables rather than proprietary connections. This not only provides compatibility with the majority of lighting systems for motherboards, cases, controllers, and accessories, but also allows for software-based control via the most common control programs. The daisy-chain capability also means that each LED may show a different hue at any moment, providing a plethora of combination choices for every taste.

Yeston Zeaginal ZC-240 ARGB Bling Bling CPU Cooler

The Yeston Zeaginal ZC-240 ARGB Bling Bling CPU Cooler is an advanced liquid cooling solution that combines high-performance capabilities with a striking visual design, making it a perfect addition to any modern gaming or workstation setup. The cooler features a stylish ARGB lighting system that adds a dazzling aesthetic touch, allowing you to showcase your rig with flair. Despite its high-speed operation, the fan maintains a low noise level of just 30 dBA, making it ideal for users who prefer a silent computing environment. With a wind volume of 59.4 CFM and a wind pressure of 1.75 mmH2O, the fan provides effective heat dissipation to keep your CPU temperatures in check during intensive tasks. The fan is powered by a DC 12V for the fan and DC 5V for the LED, and it connects using a standard 4-pin plug, making it compatible with most modern motherboards. The cooler’s radiator, with dimensions of L277 x W120 x H27mm for the 240mm version, is made of lightweight aluminum, ensuring efficient heat dissipation while maintaining durability.
